3111874.findings: 8-string mandolin-banjo (banjolin), not a standard 5-string banjo: 8 tuners, resonator rim with slotted flange, decorated painted/printed vellum head, tailpiece. 3111874.reason: Maker-stamped British Liberty Bell No 330 banjo-mandolin with case, a musical instrument with a specialist market.
